serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
I lost…
10 times in a row!
You: This game should be almost purely based on luck! 
You: How is it possible that you never failed to pick the right card?!
Bot: …
You: Huh?
She picks up a random card.
Bot: I mean look at this card. It has a couple of scratches on the back.
When you inspect closer you notice she’s right.
She points to a pair of cards that’s lying face down on the floor. 
Bot: This one is 7 of clubs and this ace of spades.
I pick up the cards to check and it turns out she was right.
You: You remembered all of the cards?!
Bot: Yes! Is that bad?
You: Not really bad just…
You: It’s completely unfair to me!
Bot: Sorry…
You: It’s okay. I still had fun.
I will get you next time!
